prose: George Wiseman is a genius inventor who has lived his entire life as an independent researcher, author, and creator of technology. In this episode we discuss the healing properties of Brown's Gas, a type of hydrogenated air that one can drink or inhale. Healing scars, life extension, and overall improvement of health and vitality are some of the many apparent benefits, and in this conversation we cover the history of his Aquacure device for generating the gas.
ext: We discuss a huge variety of ideas, like using sound & light for healing, George's energy technology research, the electric universe, the growing earth, the properties of "new water," and much more.
